source_text: Quadrigas Pharaonis et exercitum proiecit in mare; electi principes demersi sunt in rubro mari. Abyssi operuerunt eos; descenderunt in profundum sicut plumbum. Hostes invisibiles merguntur cum populus transit.
pass_a_gloss: Chariots of-Pharaoh and army he-threw into sea; chosen princes sunk are in red sea. Deeps covered them; they-descended into depth like lead. Enemies invisible are-sunk when people crosses.
pass_b_english: [[Pharaoh’s chariots and army he cast into the sea; his chosen captains sank in the Red Sea >> Bible:Exodus 15:4]]. The deeps covered them; they went down [[like lead in mighty waters >> Bible:Exodus 15:10]]. When the people pass through, unseen enemies sink.
